name: repomap
tagline: A local map of your codebase for AI agents: code graph, hybrid search, call paths, and change impact.
description: Fast local Rust MCP server (`@sylphx/repomap`) that builds a tree-sitter code graph, resolved import and call graph, PageRank centrality, Louvain module clusters, and hybrid BM25 + local embedding search across 14+ languages with no API key or vector database required. Exposes six MCP tools: `map` (architecture overview, modules, central files, and focused outlines), `search` (hybrid keyword, symbol, and semantic search with `file:line` ranges), `context` (symbol source, callers, callees, subtypes, and tests), `trace` (shortest call paths and call trees), `impact` (blast radius, callers by depth, and affected tests for symbols or `git diff`), and `db` (read-only schema and query mapping from migrations, ORMs, or live databases).

install.notes: Requires Node.js 18+. Runs locally over stdio with no API key required. Automatically indexes your workspace root; set REPOMAP_EMBED=0 to skip the one-time local embedding model download and use keyword search only.
